en-GB.description:
MenoLisa is your personal menopause companion - AI trained specifically on menopause research, paired with a personalized 8-week plan built around your symptoms.

Meet Lisa. She answers your menopause questions clearly, calmly, and without judgment. Hot flashes, mood swings, brain fog, sleep problems, weight changes, HRT, supplements - nothing is off limits. No more confusing search results or conflicting information. Just one clear, research-backed answer whenever you need it.

ASK LISA - YOUR 24/7 MENOPAUSE COMPANION
Type any question about menopause and get a clear, research-backed response in seconds. Lisa is available day and night - no appointments, no waiting rooms, no judgment. Ask the questions you have been too embarrassed to ask anyone else.

YOUR PERSONALIZED 8-WEEK PLAN
Answer a few questions and MenoLisa builds a plan around your symptoms, your body and your limits. Each week asks four simple things of you - movement, nutrition, relaxation and habits - so you always know what to do today instead of guessing.

GUIDED MOVEMENT SESSIONS
Work through your session one exercise at a time, with a timer that paces you and a screen that stays awake so you never lose your place. Sore knees, back, hips, shoulders or pelvic floor? Tell us, and the exercises that would aggravate them are removed before your plan is built.

NUTRITION AND RELAXATION, MADE SIMPLE
Tick off the day's nutrition targets in seconds, including any supplements your plan suggests. Then wind down with guided breathing and short relaxation practices for the evenings when sleep will not come.

HABITS THAT ACTUALLY STICK
Build the habits that help and let go of the ones that do not. Take on what your plan suggests, or add your own and keep them all in one place.

TRACK SYMPTOMS IN 30 SECONDS A DAY
Log how you feel each day with a simple, fast tracker designed for real life. Track hot flashes, mood changes, sleep quality, energy levels, and more - without it feeling like a chore. And a bad day is never a failed task: your plan and your symptoms are kept separate on purpose.

GENTLE REMINDERS AND A WEEKLY RECAP
Choose the reminders you want and none of the ones you do not. Each week Lisa sends a short recap of how your week actually went, so you can see the progress you would never notice day to day.

STREAKS, LEVELS AND BADGES WORTH EARNING
Small wins add up. Keep your streak, level up, and collect badges for everything you have already done - a wall of proof for the days it does not feel like progress.

WHY WOMEN CHOOSE MENOLISA

Research-backed answers written in plain language, not medical jargon
Available 24/7 - ask Lisa at 2am when you cannot sleep
A plan shaped by your symptoms and your limits, not a generic program
Private and encrypted - your data is only used to power your personal experience
Designed specifically for menopause and perimenopause

DESIGNED FOR REAL WOMEN, NOT MEDICAL JOURNALS
MenoLisa takes complex menopause research and turns it into clear, actionable information you can actually use. Whether you are just starting to notice changes or are years into your journey, Lisa meets you where you are.

MenoLisa provides educational health information and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your healthcare provider for medical decisions.
